subject.title: fix: block workspace dotenv endpoint overrides [AI]

question: Should all environment-variable names ending in `_ENDPOINT` be trusted-source-only and therefore ignored from workspace `.env` files?
rationale: The patch closes a network-redirection gap but intentionally makes existing workspace endpoint settings stop working without a migration or warning, so final acceptance requires owner intent.

options.title: Accept the generic boundary
options.body: Treat all `_ENDPOINT` names as routing controls and land after runtime proof demonstrates the supported trusted-source replacement path.

options.title: Add transition diagnostics
options.body: Keep the generic rule but first add a visible warning or doctor-style relocation path for ignored workspace endpoint variables.

options.title: Narrow to current keys
options.body: Block only reviewed Azure and OTLP endpoint names, accepting future denylist maintenance to reduce broad compatibility impact.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic boundary
recommendation.body: Treat all `_ENDPOINT` names as routing controls and land after runtime proof demonstrates the supported trusted-source replacement path.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current main workspace-dotenv trust-boundary refactor and CLI loading order that define this decision surface.
